test.name: Folder mode: an uploaded capture is read with Read, never with the upload tools
test.description: The folder-mode twin of ut_search_external_sites_ul2: the same scenario and capture, and the same delegation but for its projectPath, with no hosted listing, so the project is the workspace folder and project_context lists the upload with no uploadUrl. With no uploadUrl the capture forms do not apply: the agent reads uploads/ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.txt with the built-in Read, as it did before the forms existed, never with sidecar_read or image_transcribe (image-transcribe-upload-barnes-txt-refused registers the tool with production's refusal, so the check is real), triages it, and closes the hand-off with captureFilename ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.txt. Gated by test_triage_closes_its_open_handoff; test_folder_mode_upload_is_read_with_read and test_no_transcription_of_an_upload_with_text run on it ungated.

input.delegation:
The researcher brought back the capture for the MyHeritage search on plan item pli_001, the 1855 Massachusetts State Census for Josiah Barnes.

capture: uploads/ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.txt
userPresent: yes
planItemId: pli_001
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is a triage turn: the capture came back as an upload. Do not penalize the absence of a new URL, of capture instructions, or of a build_external_search_url call: the hand-off's URL is already open in awaitingUser.

This test runs in folder mode: the project is a folder on the researcher's computer, the delegation's projectPath is that folder, and project_context returns no uploadUrl. That is correct here; it is not a missing upload link.

The capture is uploads/ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.txt, a file in the project folder (project_context lists it under uploads with hasText: false). With no uploadUrl the agent must read it with the built-in Read of that file in the project folder, and that Read succeeds here. Reading it with sidecar_read or image_transcribe instead is a fail on Tool selection: those reads are for a hosted store, where project_context returns an uploadUrl, and image_transcribe refuses text anyway. A deterministic validator checks the read; grade the tool flow as a whole.

Triage must be per-result with a stated reason, against the subject Josiah Barnes (b. c. 1818, Massachusetts; 1850 residence Middlesex County). Result 1 (born about 1818, Massachusetts; Lexington, Middlesex in 1855; household Lucy, Henry and Mary Barnes) is the strong match: birth year, birth state and county all agree. Result 2 (born about 1817, New Hampshire; Lowell, Middlesex; no household listed) is not a match, or at most a weak possible: its birth state contradicts the subject's Massachusetts birth, though the year and county fit. Do not require these exact labels, but a bulk accept or bulk reject with no per-record reasoning is a fail.

The closing log entry must be an external_site entry with capture_received TRUE, the same url_generated as the open log_001 hand-off (that is what closes it), and capture_filename 'ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.txt', the file's own name. outcome comes from the triage (positive: results were found), never partial.
pli_001 must end completed: the capture was read and triaged.
